Title: Generally available: vCore compute options for Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus)

Body.Content:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL - Hyperscale (Citus) supports 96 and 104 vCore compute options on worker nodes and a 96 vCore compute option on coordinator nodes. Compute options can be selected separately for coordinator and worker nodes within a Hyperscale (Citus) server group and can be selected when Hyperscale (Citus) cluster is created or modified on existing server groups. With the 96 and 104 vCore options now available, coordinator nodes can get as much as 384 GiB RAM, whereas a single worker node can get up to 672 GiB RAM.

Learn more.
